messages:
Rohan S.: Quick sync: SOC2 readiness — mapping deps across teams. Draft dep map in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/depmap. Need owners for: audit logs pipeline retention policy, KMS rotation plan, HSM integration test harness, privileged access review cadence. Can folks ack & add owner? tagging @eng-infra @eng-platform @people-ops

Ashley M.: ack — I'll take audit logs retention. Will file a GH issue for S3 lifecycle + retention matrix. Blocking: need final retention window from legal (waiting on clarifying regs).

Marta L.: I can own the KMS rotation plan. Quick q: do we want automated rotation via HSM or start with cloud-KMS scheduled rotations until HSM is live? :thinking:

Tom B.: HSM delivery ETA slipped ~2w (vendor update). Recommend temporary flow: cloud KMS with key-wrapping using customer master keys. I'll add an infra note to the dep map.

Rohan S.: OK that works. Marta, coordinate with Tom on rotation automation scope. Ashley, when you create the GH issue pls tag @security and link the retention decision doc. Also we need an owner for the access review cadence (monthly/quarterly).

Priya K.: I'll take privileged access review cadence. I'll sync with People Ops on role lists and propose monthly cadence for core infra, quarterly for app-level. Will create a spreadsheet and share.

Ashley M.: putting a quick S3 lifecycle example here for the audit logs issue so infra can review:

{
  "Rules": [
    {
      "ID": "audit-logs-retention",
      "Status": "Enabled",
      "Filter": { "Prefix": "audit/" },
      "Expiration": { "Days": 3650 }
    }
  ]
}

Will adjust Days after legal confirms retention window.

Marta L.: noted. If HSM still delayed after vendor follow-up, we'll schedule rotation automation in two phases: 1) cloud-KMS scheduled rotate + ops runbook, 2) HSM-backed automated rotation once provisioned.

Tom B.: +1. I'll update the dep map with the provisional timeline and a fallback plan. Also adding a test harness ticket for HSM integration tests (hardware lab access).

eng-security-bot: Reminder: Compliance sync meeting Thu 10:00 AM. Agenda: dep map owners, retention decision, access review cadence.

Rohan S.: Thanks everyone. Next steps: owners — please create GH issues (label: soc2-dep) and update the Drive dep map by EOD tomorrow. Priya, can you share the initial access list by Mon?

Priya K.: Yep, will share Monday.

Rohan S.: Closing thread — will follow up in the compliance sync. :thumbsup:
_meta: Generated Slack thread for SOC2 dependency & owner check-in
